title: Delegation Brief and Verification Verdict
description: Canonical delegation brief handed to a subagent, and the black-box verification verdict returned to the caller. Valid for both objects: validate an instance against #/$defs/DelegationBrief or #/$defs/DelegationVerdict.

DelegationBrief.description: A self-contained delegation brief. It carries everything the worker needs and nothing it does not: no transcript, no implementation narrative.

briefId.description: Stable identifier shared by the brief and its verdict.

objective.description: The single outcome the worker must produce. One objective per brief.

outputFormat.description: summary = bounded prose with an artifact reference; artifact-reference = the worker writes a file and returns its path plus a bounded summary; findings-only = a list of findings, each with evidence, and no prose.

toolGuidance.description: Which tools and sources the worker may use, in what order, and what to do when a source is missing.

boundaries.description: What the worker must NOT do. At least one explicit negative boundary is mandatory.

stopCondition.description: The observable condition that ends the worker's run. Without it the worker keeps going until the effort budget is exhausted.

effortBudget.description: Effort scaled to task complexity. Every field is optional; the budget scales with complexity (simple, comparison, complex).

contextIsolation.description: isolated = the worker starts from a clean context and receives only the brief plus the artifact it must verify; fork = the worker inherits the caller's context.

readOnly.description: Read-only workers keep delegation safe. Mutation requires an explicit opt-in AND a mutating sideEffect declared by the invoking skill.

sources.description: Explicit sources the worker may consult (paths, URLs, commands). Empty means the brief must say so in toolGuidance.

expectedArtifactPath.description: Where the worker writes its output when outputFormat is artifact-reference.

DelegationVerdict.description: Black-box verification verdict. The verifier never sees the implementation narrative of the worker it verifies.

allOf.description: A pass is invalid without the full suite: that is the early-victory anti-pattern.
A pass over a mutating artifact is invalid without at least one negative test.

status.description: pass = every criterion met with evidence; fail = at least one criterion unmet; blocked = the verifier could not run the checks.

evidence.description: The concrete check that proved the criterion, with its location or output.

negativeTestsRun.description: Count of negative tests executed (a check that must fail before the fix is trusted).

fullSuiteRun.description: Whether the full suite was executed. A pass without it is an early victory, not a verdict.

artifactMutating.description: Whether the verified artifact mutates the repository. Mirrors the brief's readOnly flag.

summary.description: Bounded summary returned to the caller. Never a transcript of the worker's run.

artifactRef.description: Path to the verification artifact the caller may read instead of a transcript.

tokensUsed.description: Tokens spent verifying, for the effort-budget feedback loop.

durationMs.description: Wall time spent verifying, for the effort-budget feedback loop.
